<br>
<P align="left"> <B><FONT size=2 face="serif">Item 11. Description of Registrant&#146;s
      Securities to be Registered</FONT></B></P>
<P align="left"> &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">Deltic
    Timber Corporation has recently amended its Rights Agreement. The disclosure
    in the Company&#146;s Form 10 regarding its Rights Agreement is thus hereby
    amended and restated in its entirety as follows:</FONT></P>
<P align="left"> <B><FONT size=2 face="serif">Rights Agreement</FONT></B></P>
<P align="left"> &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">On December
    11, 1996, Deltic Timber Corporation (the &#147;Company&#148;) entered into
    a Rights Agreement (the &#147;Original Rights Agreement&#148;) with Harris
    N.A. (formerly known as Harris Trust and Sa&#118;ings Bank), as Rights Agent
    (the &#147;Rights Agent&#148;). The Original Rights Agreement was pre&#118;iously
    filed as Exhibit 4 to the Company&#146;s amended Annual Report on Form 10-K/A
    for the year ended December 31, 1996 and is incorporated herein by reference.
    On October 15, 1998, the Company and the Rights Agent entered into Amendment
    No. 1 to the Rights Agreement (&#147;Amendment No. 1&#148;). Amendment No.
    1 was pre&#118;iously filed as Exhibit 4.2 to this Form 10/A on No&#118;ember
    12, 1998 and is incorporated herein by reference. On October 19, 2006, the
    Company and the Rights Agent entered into Amendment No. 2 to the Rights Agreement
    (&#147;Amendment No. 2&#148;). Amendment No. 2 is filed as Exhibit 4.3 hereto
    and is incorporated herein by reference The Original Rights Agreement as
    amended by Amendment No. 1 and Amendment No. 2 is referred to herein as the &#147;Rights
    Agreement&#148;.</FONT></P>
<P align="left"> &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">On December
    11, 1996, the Board of Directors of the Company declared a di&#118;idend
    of one preferred stock purchase right (a &#147;Right&#148;) for each outstanding
    share of Common Stock of the Company, par &#118;alue &#36;.01 per share (the &#147;Company
    Common Stock&#148;), to the holders of record at the close of business of
    December 18, 1996 (the &#147;Record Date&#148;) and authorized the issuance,
    subject to the terms and conditions of the Rights Agreement, of one Right
    in respect of each share of Company Common Stock issued after the Record
    Date. As a result, each outstanding share of Company Common Stock currently
    also represents one Right. The terms and conditions of the Rights are set
    forth in the Rights Agreement, and the following description is qualified
    in its entirety by reference to the Rights Agreement.</FONT></P>
<P align="left"> &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">Prior
    to the Rights Distribution Date (as defined below), the Rights will not be
    exercisable, and will be e&#118;idenced by the certificates for, and will
    trade with, the Company Common Stock. After the Rights Distribution Date,
    the Company will issue separate certificates e&#118;idencing the Rights and
    the Rights will begin to trade separately from the Company Common Stock.</FONT></P>
<P align="left"> &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">The &#147;Rights
    Distribution Date&#148; generally means the earlier of (i) the close of business
    on the 10th day after the date (the &#147;Stock Acquisition Date&#148;) of
    the first public announcement that a person (other than the Company, any
    of its subsidiaries or any employee benefit plan of the Company or any subsidiary)
    has acquired beneficial ownership (as defined in the Rights Agreement) of
    15 percent or more of the outstanding shares of Company Common Stock (any
    such person, an &#147;Acquiring Person&#148;) and (ii) the close of business
    on the 10th business day (or such later day as may be designated by the Board
    of Directors before any person has become an Acquiring Person) after the
    date of the commencement of a tender or exchange offer by any person which
    would, if consummated, result in such person becoming an Acquiring Person.</FONT></P>
<P align="left"> &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">After
    the Rights Distribution Date, each Right will entitle the registered holder
    to purchase from the Company, upon the terms and subject to the conditions
    set forth in the Rights Agreement, one one-hundredth of a share (each such
    one-hundredth, a &#147;Unit&#148;) of Series A Participating Cumulati&#118;e
    Preferred Stock of the Company, par &#118;alue &#36;.01 per share (the &#147;Series
    A Preferred Stock&#148;), at a purchase price of &#36;200.00 per Unit, subject
    to adjustment (the &#147;Purchase Price&#148;). One Unit entitles the holder
    thereof to the same di&#118;idend and &#118;oting rights as the holder of
    one share of Company Common Stock. In lieu thereof, each Right, under certain
    circumstances as described below, will entitle its registered holder to purchase
    shares of </FONT></P>
<br>
<br>
<hr size=3 color=GRAY noshade>
<p style="page-break-before:always"></p>
<PAGE> <br>
<br>
<P align="left"> <FONT size=2 face="serif">Company Common Stock, or securities
    of a company that acquires the Company. At any time after a person has become
    an Acquiring Person, Rights that are, or (under certain circumstances specified
    in the Rights Agreement) were, beneficially owned by an Acquiring Person
    or certain affiliated persons will become null and &#118;oid.</FONT></P>
<P align="left"> &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">At any
    time after any person has become an Acquiring Person, each holder of a Right
    (other than Rights which became null and &#118;oid as described abo&#118;e)
    will thereafter ha&#118;e the right to recei&#118;e upon exercise thereof
    on or after the Distribution Date, at the then current Purchase Price, Company
    Common Stock ha&#118;ing a market &#118;alue equal to two times the Purchase
    Price.</FONT></P>
<P align="left"> &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">If at
    any time following the Stock Acquisition Date, (i) the Company is in&#118;ol&#118;ed
    in a merger or other business combination transaction in which the Company
    is not the sur&#118;i&#118;ing corporation or the Company Common Stock is
    exchanged for other securities or assets or (ii) 50 percent or more of the
    Company&#146;s assets or earning power is sold, each holder of a Right (other
    than Rights which became null and &#118;oid as described abo&#118;e) will
    thereafter ha&#118;e the right to recei&#118;e, upon exercise thereof on
    or after the Distribution Date, at the then current Purchase Price, common
    stock of the acquiring company ha&#118;ing a market &#118;alue equal to two
    times the Purchase Price.</FONT></P>
<P align="left"> &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">Until
    a Right is exercised, the holder will, as result thereof, ha&#118;e no rights
    as a stockholder of the Company, including the right to &#118;ote or to recei&#118;e
    di&#118;idends.</FONT></P>
<P align="left"> &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">The
    Rights will expire at the close of business on December 31, 2016 (the &#147;Rights
    Expiration Date&#148;), unless pre&#118;iously redeemed by the Company. The
    Rights may, at the option of the Board of Directors, be redeemed in whole,
    but not in part, at a price of &#36;.01 per Right at any time prior to the
    earlier of the Rights Distribution Date and the Rights Expiration Date. Immediately
    upon the requisite action of the Board of Directors ordering redemption of
    the Rights, the Rights will terminate, and thereafter the only right of the
    holders of Rights will be to recei&#118;e the redemption price.</FONT></P>
<P align="left"> &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">For
    so long as the Rights are redeemable, the Rights Agreement may, if the Company
    so directs, be amended by the Company and the Rights Agent in any respect
    without the appro&#118;al of any holders of Company Common Stock. At any
    time when the Rights are no longer redeemable, the Rights Agreement may,
    if the Company so directs, be amended by the Company and the Rights Agent; </FONT><I><FONT size=2
face="serif">pro&#118;ided</FONT></I><FONT size=2 face="serif"> that no such
    amendment may (a) ad&#118;ersely affect the interests of the holders of Rights
    as such (other than an Acquiring Person and certain affiliated persons),
    (b) cause the Rights Agreement to become amendable other than in accordance
    with this sentence, or (c) cause the Rights again to become redeemable. </FONT></P>
<P align="left"> &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">The
    Purchase Price payable (or, in certain cases, the number of Units of Series
    A Preferred Stock or other securities or property issuable upon exercise
    of the Rights) is subject to adjustment from time to time to pre&#118;ent
    dilution (i) in the e&#118;ent of a stock di&#118;idend on, or a subdi&#118;ision,
    combination or reclassification of, the Company Common Stock, (ii) if holders
    of the Series A Preferred Stock are granted certain rights or warrants to
    subscribe for Series A Preferred Stock or con&#118;ertible securities at
    less than the then current market price of the Series A Preferred Stock or
    (iii) upon the distribution to holders of the Series A Preferred Stock of
    e&#118;idences of indebtedness or assets (excluding regular quarterly cash
    di&#118;idends) or of subscription rights or warrants (other than those referred
    to abo&#118;e). With certain exceptions, no adjustment in the Purchase Price
    will be required until cumulati&#118;e adjustments amount to at least one
    percent of the Purchase Price. </FONT><FONT size=2 face="serif">No fractional
    Units are required to be issued and, in lieu thereof, an adjustment in cash
    will be made based on the market price of the Series A Preferred Stock on
    the last trading date prior to the date of exercise.</FONT></P>
<P align="left"> &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">The
    Rights Agreement was adopted to enable the Board of Directors to ha&#118;e
    enhanced negotiating power on behalf of stockholders in the e&#118;ent of
    a takeo&#118;er proposal. Howe&#118;er, the </FONT></P>
<P align="center"> <FONT size=2 face="serif">3</FONT></P>
<br>
<br>
<hr size=3 color=GRAY noshade>
<p style="page-break-before:always"></p>
<PAGE> <br>
<br>
<P align="left"> <FONT size=2 face="serif">Rights ha&#118;e certain anti-takeo&#118;er
    effects which may pre&#118;ent stockholders from recei&#118;ing a premium
    for their Company Common Stock and may also ha&#118;e a depressi&#118;e effect
    on the market price of the Company Common Stock. The Rights may cause substantial
    dilution to a person or group that attempts to acquire the Company without
    a condition to such an offer that a substantial number of the Rights be acquired
    or the Rights are rendered inapplicable by Board action or otherwise. The
    Company&#146;s ability to amend the Rights Agreement may, depending upon
    the circumstances, increase or decrease the anti-takeo&#118;er effects of
    the Rights. The Rights do not pre&#118;ent the Board of Directors from appro&#118;ing
    any merger or other business combination since the Rights may be redeemed,
    and the Rights Agreement may be amended, by the Board of Directors as described
    abo&#118;e. The presence of the Rights may also discourage attempts to obtain
    control of the Company by means of a hostile tender offer, e&#118;en if such
    offer would be beneficial to stockholders generally, and thereby protect
    the continuity of management.</FONT></P>
<P align="left"> &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<FONT size=2 face="serif">Stockholders
    may, depending upon the circumstances, recognize taxable income in the e&#118;ent
    that the Rights become exercisable for Series A Preferred Stock or other
    consideration as set forth abo&#118;e.</FONT></P>
<P align="center"> <FONT size=2 face="serif">4</FONT></P>
